records.subject: Cs2ScAgBr6
records.quote: The optical, electronic, thermoelectric (TE), elastic and structural features of Cs2ScXBr6 (X = Ag, Tl) are probed by using full-potential linearized augmented plane wave (FP-LAPW) method within first principles computations.
context_quotes: Tolerance factor(r) for Cs(2)AgScBr(6 )and Cs2TlScBr6 are 0.97 and 0.93, respectively, which endorse the solidity of the compound in cubic phase and negative value of enthalpy of formation (delta Hf) confirm stable nature of both compounds.The band structures (BS) show semiconductor behavior for both compounds and have direct band-gaps(Eg) of 3.34 and 3.50 eV for Cs2ScAgBr6 and Cs2ScTlBr6, correspondingly at L symmetry points.
modality_evidence: The optical, electronic, thermoelectric (TE), elastic and structural features of Cs2ScXBr6 (X = Ag, Tl) are probed by using full-potential linearized augmented plane wave (FP-LAPW) method within first principles computations.
